description: List products with optional search, sku, and status filters plus pagination.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match against product names.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of serialized product objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single product by its numeric id.

product_id.description: The unique numeric id of the product.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the serialized product; on failure (invalid id), output contains a WooCommerce error object.

description: List orders with optional customer and status filters plus pagination.

customer.description: Optional customer id to filter orders by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of serialized order objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single order by its numeric id.

order_id.description: The unique numeric id of the order.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the serialized order; on failure (invalid id), output contains a WooCommerce error object.

description: Create a new order for a customer with optional billing and line items.

customer_id.description: The customer id the order belongs to (default 0).

payment_method_title.description: Human-readable payment method title (default 'Direct Bank Transfer').

billing.description: Optional billing object with first_name, last_name, and email.

line_items.description: Optional list of line item objects with product_id and quantity used to compute totals.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created serialized order; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List customers with optional search and email filters plus pagination.

search.description: Optional substring matched against customer name or email.

email.description: Optional substring matched against customer email.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of serialized customer objects; on failure, output contains an error message.
